apis_enabled.why: Read back the exact project the customer selected.
Required by Workload Identity Federation token exchange.
The Security Token Service endpoint that performs the exchange.

iam_roles_granted.why: roles/browser is read-only project metadata. It is the narrowest predefined role that lets KuiperDesk prove which project it reached. It grants no data access, no compute access and no IAM mutation.

network_impact.summary: None. This blueprint touches no networking resource and opens no ingress.

quota_findings.failure_mode: Infrastructure Manager preview fails before apply if the project is at its limit.

quota_findings.quota: Workload Identity Pool providers per pool
quota_findings.failure_mode: Infrastructure Manager preview fails before apply if the pool is at its limit.
serviceusage.googleapis.com returns a quota error at preview; no partial enablement is applied.

cost_basis: Workload Identity Pools, providers and IAM bindings carry no Google Cloud charge. Enabling an API carries no charge by itself.

delete_behavior.why_retains: Other workloads in the customer project may already depend on these APIs. Uninstalling KuiperDesk must never disable an API it did not exclusively own.
